subject: Vulnerability management evidence: SAST/DAST summary + pen-test synopsis for Peregrine Financial
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@peregrine-fin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: security@peregrine-fin.com
Date: Sat, 3 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vulnerability management evidence request — Peregrine RFP

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the initial RFP response last week. Our security team has a few follow-ups focused on vulnerability management and evidence for evaluation: SAST/DAST coverage, recent penetration test summary, patch SLA commitments for third-party deps, and an SBOM export. Specific asks below: 

1) Brief SAST program summary (tools, cadence, coverage) and a short PDF with high-level findings for the last 6 months.
2) DAST scan output or CSV for a sample staging run (we'll redact sensitive endpoints).
3) Pen test summary report highlighting critical/medium findings and remediation status.
4) Your standard patch SLA for CVEs in third-party libraries and any exception handling.
5) A machine-readable SBOM (CycloneDX or SPDX) for the inference runtime components.

Can you confirm you can provide redacted artifacts and an estimated delivery date? Our deadline to share with procurement is EOD Wednesday (2025-05-07).

Best,
Alice Monroe
Head of Security Programs
Peregrine Financial

--
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@peregrine-fin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 3 May 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vulnerability management evidence request — Peregrine RFP

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver redacted artifacts and a concise executive summary. High-level plan and owners below: 

- SAST: we run a nightly build scan (internal pipeline) using Semgrep and CodeQL; research team engages on high-risk findings weekly. Marissa will prepare a 2-page SAST digest (owner: Marissa).
- DAST: internal dynamic scans for public endpoints via ZAP and a scheduled authenticated scan for staging (owner: Jonas). We'll export CSV of the last staging run and redact paths as requested.
- Pen test: summary from April 25 pen test (third-party vendor). We will provide the 2-page executive synopsis with remediation statuses and dates. (owner: Karthik).
- Patch SLA: standard policy is 30 days for critical (P0/P1) and 90 days for medium/low with faster remediation where exploitability is high. We'll attach our formal patch SLA doc. (owner: Ben Carter for compliance exceptions).
- SBOM: we can export a CycloneDX SBOM for the runtime and container images (owner: Jonas).

Estimated delivery: Friday EOD PT (2025-05-05). If you need anything earlier, let us know which items are highest priority. I'll follow up with the artifacts and upload them to a shared Drive link, and include a short pen-test synopsis PDF and SAST digest.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Trust Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none on this message

--
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@peregrine-fin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 5 May 2025 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vulnerability management evidence request — Peregrine RFP

Alice — attaching the deliverables here and in the Drive link. Quick notes inline: 

Attachments:
- redwood_sast_digest_v1.2.pdf (PDF) — two pages, summarizes rulesets, recent high/med findings, and mitigations.
- dast-scan-results-2025-04-28.csv (CSV) — sanitized, all internal hostnames removed. Columns: endpoint, vuln_id, severity, request_sample.
- pen-test-summary-peregrine-0425.pdf (PDF) — vendor exec summary + outstanding remediation plan (all critical fixed; two medium issues are scheduled).
- sbom-export-20250430.json (JSON) — CycloneDX 1.4 export for runtime images (sha256 references included).

Key clarifications:
- Critical CVEs: our practice is to patch in 30 days; we have a documented emergency patch path (24–72 hrs) when exploitability is confirmed.
- Third-party deps: we maintain a weekly automated inventory and a triage board — we've included a short appendix in the SAST digest explaining the process.
- Pen test: vendor confirmed remediation of the single critical finding on 2025-04-29; medium items have ETA 2025-05-18.

Shared Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/peregrine/vm-evidence
DocuSign for NDA addendum (if needed): https://docusign.com/packet/ABCD-1234

If you want raw logs or a live demo of the staging scan, we can schedule a 30-minute session this week.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Senior Application Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@peregrine-fin.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: security@peregrine-fin.com, Trevor Lim <trevor.lim@peregrine-fin.com>
Date: Tue, 6 May 2025 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vulnerability management evidence request — Peregrine RFP

Jonas / Marissa — received and reviewing. Quick follow-ups from our security review: 

- Thanks for the SBOM export — can you confirm whether build-time dependencies (dev/prod separation) are included, or is this runtime-only? If runtime-only, can you provide a short note on dev-dep handling and any measures to ensure dev tools are not present in production images?
- For the DAST CSV: please add a column that indicates whether the finding has a corresponding JIRA ticket and current status (open/resolved). If you can’t add it to the CSV, a small mapping table will suffice.
- Confirm the SLA for patching components with known public exploit proof-of-concept; is the 30-day target shortened for those to 7 days?

If you can respond by EOD Thursday (2025-05-08) that would keep us on track for procurement timelines. We may request a brief call to walk a couple items offline.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Best,
Alice Monroe
Head of Security Programs
Peregrine Financial

--
